scope: Current JSX control declarations, including conditional and repeated controls. This inventory is not evidence that every control was clicked.

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {() => { if (!item.read) void markRead([item.id]); onNavigate(item.section, item.date); close(); }}

controls.label: Force clock out all ( )
controls.handler: {() => setSelection({ scope: 'all', employeeIds: active.map((employee) => employee.employeeId), date })}

controls.label: Clock out
controls.handler: {() => setSelection({ scope: 'individual', employeeIds: [employee.employeeId], date, name: employee.name })}

controls.label: {`${value}${selected ? ", selected" : ""}`}
controls.handler: {() => { setDate(value); setDates(current => current.includes(value) ? current.filter(item => item !== value) : [...current, value].sort()); setError(""); }}

controls.label: Clock in selected ( )
controls.handler: {() => { setSelectedIds(selectedForClockIn.map(employee => employee.id)); setBulk({ action: "time-in", ids: selectedForClockIn.map(employee => employee.id), mode: "selected" }); }}

controls.label: Clock out selected ( )
controls.handler: {() => { setSelectedIds(selectedForClockOut.map(employee => employee.id)); setBulk({ action: "time-out", ids: selectedForClockOut.map(employee => employee.id), mode: "selected" }); }}

controls.label: Clock in all not yet in ( )
controls.handler: {() => { setBulk({ action: "time-in", ids: notYet.map(employee => employee.id), mode: "all" }); setSelectedIds(notYet.map(employee => employee.id)); }}

controls.label: Clock out all clocked in ( )
controls.handler: {() => { setBulk({ action: "time-out", ids: clockedIn.map(employee => employee.id), mode: "all" }); setSelectedIds(clockedIn.map(employee => employee.id)); }}

controls.label: Retry validation
controls.handler: {() => void updateOfflineItem({ ...item, status: 'pending', error: undefined }).catch(cause => toast({ title: 'Retry unavailable', description: cause.message, variant: 'error' }))}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {async () => { if (!discardItem) return; setDiscarding(true); setDiscardError(''); try { await deleteOfflineItem(discardItem.id); setDiscardItem(null); toast({ title: 'Local record removed', description: 'Server attendance was not changed.', variant: 'success' }); } catch (cause) { setDiscardError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'Unable to remove this local record. Try again.'); } finally { setDiscarding(false); } }}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {event => setSelected(current => event.target.checked ? [...new Set([...current, ...shownEligible.map(entry => entry.requestId!)])].slice(0, 500) : current.filter(id => !shownEligible.some(entry => entry.requestId === id)))}

controls.label: {`Select ${entry.employeeName}`}
controls.handler: {event => setSelected(current => event.target.checked ? [...current, entry.requestId!] : current.filter(id => id !== entry.requestId))}

controls.label: Select all records ( )
controls.handler: {() => setSelection({ key: selectionKey, all: true, ids: [] })}

controls.label: Clear selection
controls.handler: {() => setSelection({ key: selectionKey, all: false, ids: [] })}

controls.label: Delete selected ( )
controls.handler: {() => { setDeleteError(''); setPendingDelete({ ids: currentSelection.all ? [] : currentSelection.ids, allMatching: currentSelection.all, excludedIds: currentSelection.all ? currentSelection.ids : [], filters: { search, status: filter, type, from, to }, count: selectedCount }); }}

controls.label: {`Select archived employee ${account.name}`}
controls.handler: {event => setSelectedArchiveIds(current => event.target.checked ? [...new Set([...current, account.id])] : current.filter(id => id !== account.id))}

controls.label: {`${shortDate(day.date)}: ${day.working ? `${day.expectedPresent} employees expected` : "No work scheduled"}. Show past records.`}
Record cash given without a request
Retry
controls.handler: {() => { const controller = new AbortController(); void load(controller.signal) }}

controls.label: Edit contact information
controls.handler: {() => { setContactDraft({ phone: profile.phone || '', address: profile.address || '' }); setEditingContact(true); }}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {event => { setReviewPast(event.target.checked); if (!event.target.checked) setApprovalDates(current => current.filter(date => date >= approvalPreview.today)); }}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {() => confirmApproval ? reviewTarget && void updateRequest(reviewTarget.id, 'approved', approvalDates) : setConfirmApproval(true)}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {async e=>{e.preventDefault();setSaving(true);setError("");try{const r=await apiFetch("/api/payroll-requests/bonus",{method:"PATCH",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({scope,requestId,amount:Number(amount),periodStart:period})});const d=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));if(!r.ok)throw new Error(d.error||"Bonus was not added");await onSaved(Number(d.updated||0))}catch(reason){const message=reason instanceof Error?reason.message:"Bonus was not added";setError(message);toast({title:"Bonus not added",description:message,variant:"error"})}finally{setSaving(false)}}}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {async e=>{e.preventDefault();setSaving(true);setError("");try{const r=await apiFetch("/api/payroll-requests/pay-bulk",{method:"PATCH",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({ids:requests.map(x=>x.id),periodStart:period,password})});const d=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));if(!r.ok)throw new Error(d.error||"Payroll was not updated");await onPaid(d.ids||[])}catch(reason){const message=reason instanceof Error?reason.message:"Unable to complete payroll";setError(message);toast({title:"Payroll payment failed",description:message,variant:"error"})}finally{setSaving(false)}}}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {async e=>{e.preventDefault();setSaving(true);setError("");try{await onSubmit(target.employee,target.request,target.action,password);onClose()}catch(reason){const message=reason instanceof Error?reason.message:"Unable to update payroll";setError(message);toast({title:"Payroll not updated",description:message,variant:"error"})}finally{setSaving(false)}}}

controls.label: days
controls.handler: {() => setShift({ workDays: days, workWeekdays: Array.from({ length: days }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((day) => day === 7 ? 0 : day) })}

controls.label: (dynamic or icon control)
controls.handler: {() => setShift({ workWeekdays: selected ? settings.shift.workWeekdays.filter((value) => value !== day) : settings.shift.workWeekdays.length < settings.shift.workDays ? [...settings.shift.workWeekdays, day as number] : settings.shift.workWeekdays })}
